title: Sexual health in elder care
blurb: Developed at the LGBT+ nursing home Slottet. Training and toolkits that meet older adults' sexuality with dignity and supports health care staff in their work with sexual health.
body: My work in the elder care sector can be seen at ældreseksualitet.dk
